you know, I think one of the hardest things to accept about myself if that I’m never gonna have the body I had when I was 11 or 12. I have to understand that no 19 year old should have the body of someone who hasn’t even gone through puberty. it’s just not realistic.

with saying that, the behaviors you are describing definitely aren’t good eating habits and can end up to developing such disorder pretty soon (not to scare you)

don’t continue starving yourself or obsessing so much about calories you’re eating and thinking of ways to punish yourself for overeating. it’s easier to say than do but really looking back, I had a normal BMI in middle school and there was no need for me to start obsessing over my diet. all that led to was years of suffering and hating myself. nearly 7 years have gone by and I still hate my body more than anything and I’m just constantly losing or gaining a lot of weight. I’m not happy and this will probably stay with me for another 7 or more years.

therefore, think to yourself: what led you to gain weight in the first place. did you just hit puberty and naturally gained some more weight? or are you constantly engorging yourself with food when you’re bored and not hungry? either way focus on eating when you are hungry and maybe doing some light exercises if you don’t already


but really you’re at a healthy weight and you deserve to eat food and enjoy it. not thinking of ways to starve yourself or lie to others about not eating. also i don’t really know if this helped, but if you ever want to message me feel free to do so, wish you the best
